necessary_context.content: Euclidean x in R^{d_x}; known nonempty compact convex Y subset R^{d_y} with diameter at most D_Y. f=n^{-1}sum_i f_i is concave in y; individual components need not be concave. Components are differentiable on a neighborhood of the product domain. Phi=max_Y f is bounded below with initial gap at most Delta. AS means the average squared joint-gradient difference is at most L^2 times squared point distance; IS requires each component gradient to be L-Lipschitz. A selectable component query returns its exact value and full joint gradient. Projection onto known Y and internal computation are free; unknown maximizers, prox and Moreau gradients are not supplied.
necessary_context.name: Model and Oracle

necessary_context.content: A=L Delta/epsilon^2, B=L D_Y/epsilon, Bbar=max{1,B}. Phi_{1/(2L)}(c)=min_x{Phi(x)+L||x-c||^2}. The target is its gradient norm at most epsilon with probability at least 2/3 and a deterministic component-query cap on every transcript and seed. Worst cases include admissible known domains and finite dimensions.
